Fetches Alpine Linux security database YAML files from the Alpine SecDB API for specified versions.

## Key Components

- **`newFetchRequests(target []string)`** — Builds a slice of `FetchRequest` objects for each Alpine version, always including the `main` repository feed and conditionally including the `community` feed (skipped for version `3.2`).
- **`FetchFiles(versions []string)`** — Public entry point that constructs fetch requests and retrieves YAML security feeds via `util.FetchFeedFiles`. Returns an error if no versions are provided or if fetching fails.

## Constants

| Constant | URL Pattern |
|---|---|
| `main` | `https://secdb.alpinelinux.org/v%s/main.yaml` |
| `community` | `https://secdb.alpinelinux.org/v%s/community.yaml` |

## Usage Example

```go
results, err := alpine.FetchFiles([]string{"3.17", "3.18", "3.19"})
if err != nil {
    log.Fatal(err)
}

for _, result := range results {
    fmt.Printf("Fetched: %s\n", result.Target)
}
```

> **Note:** Version `3.2` only fetches the `main` feed — the `community` feed is excluded for that release.
